# email-cloudflare

> Generated by `scripts/docs-generate.ts` from `modules/email-cloudflare/registry-item.json` and its skill. Do not edit this file. Run `pnpm docs:generate` to update it.

An email provider on Cloudflare Email Sending, which needs a paid Workers plan and an onboarded domain.

## Install

```saasaloy-command task=add name=email-cloudflare
saasaloy add email-cloudflare
saasaloy env
pnpm install
```

1. Run `saasaloy add email-cloudflare --dry-run` to print the plan and write nothing. Check the files it writes and the modules it adds first.
2. Run `saasaloy add email-cloudflare --yes` to write the files.
3. Run `saasaloy env` to fill the environment values the new modules declare. With no terminal, pass each value as `--set KEY=VALUE`.
4. Run `pnpm install` to fetch the new dependencies.
5. This module ships no skill. Read the `email` skill under [What your agent reads](email.md#what-your-agent-reads) and follow it to use the module in your code.
